notes: The Reach has high ground at last. The burnt-dark cinderreach now stands taller than the ground you start on, so there is somewhere to walk toward — until now every region was flatter than the shrine's country, and travel could only take you down.

That country is genuinely steeper to cross than it was. Climbing it is work now where it used to be a stroll, which is the point of high ground. Nothing became impossible to climb, and no slope anywhere in the world got steeper than the steepest slope that was already there.
The ground you spawn on has not moved at all. The shrine's clearing is the same terrain it was, to the millimetre.
Cover thins as the land rises, so the new high ground reads as open and exposed while the hollows keep their scrub.

Still short of the mark: the ground itself has no real material on it yet — no surface detail that catches the low sun — so the new slopes read as smooth painted dunes rather than as ash and stone. The shape landed; the surface has not.
title: The Reach has high ground
